title: Day 19: Pre-Listing Repairs & Improvements That Pay Off
body:
People searching Austin-area real estate for “what repairs to make before selling Austin”, “home improvements that increase value Texas”, and “pre listing checklist Austin” want a local, practical answer.

Not every upgrade returns dollar-for-dollar. High-ROI items in the current market tend to be: roof and HVAC condition (or recent replacement documentation), neutral paint, flooring updates in high-traffic areas, and curb appeal (landscaping, exterior paint, clean entry).

Over-improving kitchens or baths beyond the neighborhood standard rarely recovers full cost.

A pre-listing inspection lets sellers address issues on their own timeline and cost rather than negotiating credits later. Buyers notice deferred maintenance quickly.

If you are weighing a list date, a price, or a repair list, The Banks Group will run the numbers for your street and help you decide. Start with a complimentary conversation.
